description: Validate Japanese Peppol e-invoices (JP PINT 1.1.3 UBL Invoice XML) with JPVerify against the official OASIS UBL 2.1 XSD and OpenPeppol JP PINT Schematron, optionally checking the seller's qualified-invoice T-number in the National Tax Agency registry. Use when a task involves checking a JP PINT / Peppol (デジタルインボイス) XML invoice before sending it, accepting it into accounting, or paying it. Paid per call (API key credits or x402).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
